BrochureContent.Content:
Gary O'Driscoll & Co. Ltd are delighted to bring to the market this completely refurbished four-bedroom semi-detached residence, ideally situated in the ever-popular Monavalley area of Tralee. Located within a mature and peaceful cul-de-sac, No. 6 Woodbrook Manor offers a superb opportunity to acquire a modern, turnkey home in a highly convenient location.

The property has been comprehensively refurbished throughout and is presented in excellent condition. The works include a brand-new kitchen, new bathrooms, new flooring throughout and a new oil-fired central heating system. The property also benefits from white double-glazed PVC windows, complementing the fresh and contemporary finish throughout the accommodation.

The spacious accommodation provides excellent living space, with four well-proportioned bedrooms and modern bathroom facilities, making this an ideal family home or investment property.

The location is a particular feature of this property, being just approximately 1.4 km from Tralee Town Centre and within easy reach of a wide range of local amenities, schools, shops and services. Munster Technological University Kerry Campus is approximately 3.2 km away, while Mercy Mounthawk Secondary School is approximately 2.8 km from the property.

Situated in a mature, quiet cul-de-sac while remaining within close proximity of Tralee Town Centre, No. 6 Woodbrook Manor offers the perfect combination of modern accommodation, convenience and a peaceful residential setting.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the standard of refurbishment and excellent location this property has to offer.
